$comment: Maps accessibility pattern identifiers (DRU-, MS-, and their dual-written a11y/pattern/v1 fingerprints) to tracked Drupal.org issues. See tools/a11y-fingerprints.js for identifier generation and https://mgifford.github.io/ACCESSIBILITY.md/examples/ACCESSIBILITY_FINDING_TRACKING.html for the tracker-ID vs. pattern-fingerprint distinction this file exists to preserve.
notes: A tracker ID here is the Drupal.org issue URL for tracked remediation work. It is assigned by a human filing or linking an issue, never computed from a pattern ID.
A pattern's presence in this file does not mean its Drupal.org issue is still open, and its absence does not mean no issue exists — it means no issue has been linked here yet.

Do not add an entry to this file by guessing which Drupal.org issue 'probably' corresponds to a pattern. Only add an entry when a specific pattern ID has actually been cited in a filed Drupal.org issue, an MR, or a comment, or a maintainer has explicitly confirmed the link.
relationship values follow examples/ACCESSIBILITY_FINDING_TRACKING.md's tracker relationship vocabulary: tracks, duplicates, relates-to, blocks, blocked-by, supersedes, superseded-by.
